title.narrative: Shandong West Jining Water Supply and Drainage Integration Program

description.narrative: The proposed program will be the first sector development program (SDP) for the water sector in the PRC and the first ADB SDP implemented at a county level. The SDP aims to address the water sector needs and development constraints of Jiaxiang County, an extremely water sensitive area in the People's Republic of China (PRC), by (i) addressing the policy and institutional gaps and mitigating climate risks, (ii) integrating water supply and delivery of sewerage services, (iii) improving public health and environmental quality of waterways, and (iv) enhancing institutional and program management capacity, under an integrated and long-term approach, where policy and institutional reforms and infrastructure investments are required.
